description: React component for a recruiter-focused profile page with skills management, including profile details and skills list, using hooks and external services (mocked for now).

methods.name: onProfileChange
methods.description: Handles updates to profile form fields, resets profileSaved flag.

methods.name: onSaveProfile
methods.description: Saves profile data, currently in mock mode; placeholder for real save via Supabase.

methods.name: onRefresh
methods.description: Refreshes profile data, placeholder for loading from remote source.

methods.name: addSkillHandler
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the list, currently in mock mode.

methods.name: removeSkillHandler
methods.description: Removes a skill from the list.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the proficiency level of a skill.
